models.name: Minimal Add Network (Test)
models.description: A trivial 2x2 Add graph used by CI unit tests. Not used by any UI feature.

models.name: NAFNet Denoise (sRGB, width64)
models.description: NAFNet-SIDD-width64 denoising. Operates on sRGB-normalized F32 input. Upstream source: qualcomm/NAFNet-DeNoise (MIT). download_url points to a 410 MB ZIP containing nafnet_denoise.onnx (graph, ~1.9 MB) + nafnet_denoise.data (weights, ~442 MB) — the ONNX external-data pattern. ModelManager::extractOnnxFromZip flattens both into the cache dir, renames the .onnx to filename, and keeps the .data sibling (the .onnx graph references it by leaf name). Static input resolution is 256x256 (not arbitrary H x W). Verified end-to-end via tests/nafnet_smoke.cpp (extract + load + 256x256 denoise pass).

models.name: Subject Segmentation (BiRefNet_lite)
models.description: Foreground/background segmentation via BiRefNet_lite (MIT). Replaces BRIA RMBG-2 (non-commercial license). Outputs a 1-channel alpha mask in [0,1]. 1024x1024 input. fp32 ONNX, 224 MB. SHA256 verified against HF LFS oid.

models.name: U²Net Sky Approximation
models.description: Sky approximation using the general-purpose U²Net salient-object model distributed by rembg (MIT). This is not a sky-specific segmentation model: AiMaskGenerator applies the existing sky heuristic as a fallback when the model is unavailable, and the result may include other salient foreground regions. Downloaded on demand; not bundled with the installer.

models.name: SkySeg (U²Net sky)
models.description: Dedicated sky-region segmentation, U²Net architecture trained on sky (upstream JianyuanWang/skyseg). Replaces the generic salient-object U²Net for the Sky mask target: cleaner sky/cloud boundaries, fewer stray foreground regions. Downloaded on demand; not bundled with the installer.

models.name: MobileSAM Image Encoder
models.description: MobileSAM (ChaoningZhang/MobileSAM) image encoder, 1024x1024 NHWC input -> 256x64x64 image embedding. Stage 1 of click-prompt segmentation (runSamPoint).

models.name: MobileSAM Mask Decoder
models.description: MobileSAM promptable mask decoder (point / box prompts). Stage 2 of click-prompt segmentation: consumes the encoder image-embedding plus prompt points/labels and emits low-res masks + IoU predictions (runSamPoint).

models.name: MobileNetV3-Small Embedding
models.description: 1280-dim feature extractor for duplicate detection (ImageNet pre-trained). 224x224 input.
